name: digital-marketing-pro
title_zh: 品牌上下文喂进去，策略到报表七环节全给你出活
tagline_zh: 别家AI营销工具只给通用模板，它先吞下你的品牌定位再动手。从SEO到付费投放，每份产出都带引用来源，你敢直接拿去用。
tagline_en: Generic templates won't cut it. This AI ops system ingests your brand context first, then drafts SEO, ads, CRM &.
desc_en: An open-source AI marketing operating system for strategy, SEO, AEO/GEO, paid media, content, CRM, and analytics - grounded in brand context, human approval, and verifiable outputs.
why_zh: 把品牌手册当系统提示词，所有策略自动对齐定位；每项产出强制附来源链接，幻觉内容在生成环节就被掐断。
why_en: Feeds your brand book as system prompt so every output aligns to positioning; enforces source citations at generation.
limit_zh: 需自备品牌手册/定位文档喂入，否则输出退化为通用模板；覆盖策略、SEO、AEO/GEO、付费、内容、CRM。
limit_en: Requires your brand book/positioning doc as input, else outputs degrade to generic. Covers 7 areas (strategy, SEO, AEO/GEO, paid, content, CRM.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Brand-context AI ops for strategy, SEO, ads, CRM & reports
